updates.geometric_difference: Compared to the launch car, a new engine cover exit is available which reduces the exit area at the rear of the car.
updates.description: The smaller engine cover exit panels optimise the air mass flow through the cooling system, which keep the PU, Gbox and hydraulic fluids in the correct temperature window to suit the conditions and nature of the Melbourne circuit.

updates.geometric_difference: A new FWEP Dive Plane geometry has been designed which has an alternative profile to the launch car configuration.
updates.description: This detailed geometric change works with the overall profiles of the launch front wing elements to generate flow structures that help deliver efficient load from the rest of the car.

updates.geometric_difference: Compared to the launch car, a new floor update is available which features a new floor winglet/cutout ahead of the rear tyres.
updates.description: These detailed geometric updates offer both direct load from the local region as well as generating flow structures that help deliver efficient load from the rear of the floor.

updates.geometric_difference: New winglets and RW pillar extensions have been designed as optional parts to be fitted to the Launch spec RW assy.
updates.description: These revised RW Pillar profiles work to improve the aerodynamic performance of the upper RW elements under Corner Mode operation.
